name: Xoi
summary: Xôi is dense sticky rice, savoury or sweet. Vietnam Tourism calls savoury xôi mặn an inexpensive breakfast and says there are more than 20 sweet kinds. The Hanoi door on that list is Xôi Yến.
origin: The dish list places the Hanoi bowl at Xôi Yến in Hoàn Kiếm. Five-colour sticky rice on the same list is a type, not this city’s only xôi.
howToEat: Xôi mặn is the savoury breakfast. Xôi ngọt is the sweet side, and the list says there are more than 20 sweet kinds.
The same list describes xôi ngũ sắc as purple, green, red, yellow, and white, coloured with plant extracts. It does not say that bowl is the one at Xôi Yến.
where: Xôi Yến, 35B Nguyễn Hữu Huân, Lý Thái Tổ, Hoàn Kiếm. The hour is Check on arrival.
seoDescription: Xôi in Hanoi is dense sticky rice, savoury at breakfast or sweet. Vietnam Tourism names Xôi Yến at 35B Nguyễn Hữu Huân.
